question: E, F, G, H, P, S, and T are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F sits second to the right of T. P sits to the immediate left of S. Only one person sits between P and G when counted from the left of P. H sits third to the right of E. How many people are sitting between H and P when counted from the right of H?
solution:
**Given: **E, F, G, H, P, S, and T are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

F sits second to the right of T.

P sits to the immediate left of S.

Only one person sits between P and G when counted from the left of P.

H sits third to the right of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7573f964c8ae3f90a3e89a0f70bcbf0c59c21d29d0bc6ccc2f0315817c798ad1.png] 

Thus, None are sitting between H and P when counted from the right of H.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
